provider.drive.name: Google Drive
provider.onedrive.name: Microsoft OneDrive
menu.welcome:
Welcome to CloudDrives!
This tool mounts OneDrive and Google Drive as drives in Windows.
First, let's connect an account. You sign in securely in your browser and
enter your password only on Microsoft's or Google's own page.

support.title: Support bundle
support.explain:
The support bundle helps with troubleshooting: diagnosis, versions, settings and the logs of the last 7 days.
It contains no passwords, tokens, keys or file contents. E-mail addresses, user and computer name are
redacted. Error messages may contain file and folder names.
support.readme:
CloudDrives {0} - support bundle of {1}

Contents:
  report.txt / report.json   result of the diagnosis
  system.txt                 versions of Windows, PowerShell, rclone and WinFsp
  settings.json              settings (without names of signed-in users)
  engine.txt                 background service state, remotes without secret values, drives, cache
  logs\                      logs of the last 7 days

Not included: passwords, tokens, keys, client secrets and file contents.
E-mail addresses, user name, computer name and profile paths are redacted.
Before saving, the bundle was checked for every secret CloudDrives knows.
Error messages may contain file and folder names.
settings.title: Settings
settings.watchdogExplain:
Every 5 minutes, after waking up from standby and after network changes, the watchdog checks
whether your drives are connected and reconnects them if necessary. Drives you disconnect yourself stay disconnected.

watchdog.cycle.busy: CloudDrives is busy - the next cycle follows shortly.
watchdog.cycle.offline: No internet connection - the next cycle follows shortly.
watchdog.cycle.failed: Not all drives could be connected.
doctor.watchdogOff: off - after standby or a crash the drives stay disconnected

install.question: Install CloudDrives
install.explain:
CloudDrives is currently running from an arbitrary folder. Installing copies it to
{0} (no administrator rights) and adds a Start menu shortcut.
Afterwards you can move or delete the current folder - autostart and drives keep working.
install.later: You can install CloudDrives at any time under Settings.
install.startHint: From now on, start CloudDrives from the Start menu or the desktop shortcut.
app.restarting: CloudDrives now restarts from the program folder - a new window opens.
update.upToDate: You already have the latest version ({0}).
update.notInstalled: Version {0} is available. Updates are only available for the installed version - install CloudDrives first (Settings).
update.notify: CloudDrives version {0} is available. Open CloudDrives > Settings > Check for updates.
uninstall.explain:
CloudDrives is removed from this PC: drives are disconnected, autostart and shortcuts are deleted.
Your files in the cloud stay unchanged.
uninstall.removeData: Also delete sign-ins, settings and cache on this PC?
uninstall.winfspNote: The WinFsp driver stays installed (other programs may use it). You can remove it under Windows Settings > Apps.
autostart.question: Connect automatically
autostart.explain:
Should CloudDrives connect your drives automatically and invisibly every time you sign in to Windows -
and again after standby, a network change or a crash?
If something goes wrong (e.g. an expired sign-in) you get a Windows notification.
A symbol in the notification area shows the status and offers the most important commands.
autostart.later: You can turn this on at any time under Settings.
autostart.enabled: Autostart is on - the drives are connected when you sign in to Windows.
notify.reloginHint: Open CloudDrives > Manage accounts > Sign in again.
status.noDrives: No drives set up yet. Press [3] to add an account.
disconnect.pendingExplain:
Files are still being uploaded to the cloud. If you disconnect now,
the upload resumes automatically the next time you connect.
disconnect.wait: Wait until everything is uploaded (Esc stops waiting)

relogin.explain:
Drives and settings are kept. The previous sign-in is only replaced once the new one works
and belongs to the same account.
relogin.useAccount: Sign in with {0} in the browser.
relogin.useSameAccount: Sign in with the account that belongs to "{0}" in the browser.

setup.title: Setup
setup.intro: CloudDrives now checks the required components and sets them up if needed.
setup.winfsp.explain:
Drive letters require the WinFsp driver.
Installing it needs administrator rights once: Windows will ask for your
confirmation (User Account Control). Please confirm with "Yes".
setup.winfsp.declined: Without WinFsp no drives can be mounted. You can run the setup again at any time.
setup.winfsp.installing: Installing WinFsp - please confirm the Windows prompt ...
setup.secure.ok: Encrypted storage is set up (key stored in the Windows Credential Manager).

vault.title: Encrypted vault for "{0}"
vault.explain:
Files in the vault are encrypted on this PC before they are uploaded - including file and folder
names. In the cloud (browser, phone app) only gibberish is visible. The vault lives in its own folder,
your other files stay unchanged.

manage.labelTooShort: Please enter a name with at least 2 characters - you have already chosen the drive letter.

wizard.remove.title: Remove account
wizard.remove.explain:
The account is disconnected and its sign-in is deleted from this PC.
Your files in the cloud are not changed.
wizard.remove.revokeHint: Tip: at {0} you can also revoke the access at the provider.
help.text:
Usage: CloudDrives.bat [command] [options]

  (no command)               open the menu
  connect | verbinden        connect drives (all, or e.g. "connect K")
  disconnect | trennen       disconnect drives (--force: despite running uploads)
  status                     show status (--json for scripts)
  autostart on|off           connect the drives automatically when Windows starts
  install | installieren     install to %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\CloudDrives (--desktop)
  update | aktualisieren     install the latest version (--check: only check)
  uninstall | deinstallieren remove CloudDrives (--remove-data: also sign-ins)
  add-account                add an account
  remove-account             remove an account
  relogin | neu-anmelden     sign an account in again without removing it (e.g. "relogin K")
  change-client | client-id  change the own Google client ID of an account
  doctor | diagnose          diagnosis (--fix: fix automatically, --bundle: support bundle, --json)
  watchdog [on|off|status]   reconnect automatically (without option: check once now)
  tray [on|off|status]       notification area symbol (without option: show it now)
  setup | einrichten         check or install rclone and WinFsp
  version                    show the program version
  help | hilfe               this help

Options:
  --silent                   no output (for autostart)

Logs: %LOCALAPPDATA%\CloudDrives\logs
error.CD-0001.title: Already connected
error.CD-0002.title: Not connected
error.CD-1001.title: rclone is missing
error.CD-1001.fix: Run the setup (CloudDrives.bat setup) - rclone is downloaded automatically.
error.CD-1002.title: WinFsp is not installed
error.CD-1002.fix: Run the setup (CloudDrives.bat setup) and confirm the Windows prompt.
error.CD-1003.title: rclone is too old
error.CD-1003.fix: Run the setup to install the matching rclone version.
error.CD-1004.title: Download failed
error.CD-1004.fix: Check the internet connection (or proxy/firewall) and try again.
error.CD-1005.title: PowerShell is too old
error.CD-1005.fix: CloudDrives needs Windows PowerShell 5.1 (Windows 10/11) or PowerShell 7.
error.CD-1006.title: Checksum or signature mismatch
error.CD-1006.fix: The downloaded file was discarded for security reasons. Please try again later.
error.CD-1007.title: Administrator confirmation cancelled
error.CD-1007.fix: Run the setup again and confirm the Windows prompt with "Yes".
error.CD-2001.title: Settings are invalid
error.CD-2001.fix: settings.json is damaged. A backup is stored as settings.json.bak in the same folder.
error.CD-2002.title: Stored sign-in data cannot be decrypted
error.CD-2002.fix: The key does not match the configuration. Remove and reconnect the accounts if needed.
error.CD-2003.title: The key for the sign-in data is missing
error.CD-2003.fix: The key in the Windows Credential Manager was deleted. Accounts have to be reconnected.
error.CD-2004.title: Master password required
error.CD-2004.fix: Open CloudDrives and enter your master password.
error.CD-2005.title: Settings were written by a newer version
error.CD-2005.fix: Update CloudDrives to the latest version.
error.CD-2006.title: Account or drive not found
error.CD-2006.fix: Check the name or drive letter (CloudDrives.bat status).
error.CD-3001.title: Sign-in expired or revoked
error.CD-3001.fix: Sign the account in again: Manage accounts > Sign in again (or "CloudDrives.bat relogin").
error.CD-3002.title: The provider is throttling requests (rate limit)
error.CD-3002.fix: Wait a moment. For Google, an own client ID helps permanently (see docs/GOOGLE-OAUTH.md).
error.CD-3003.title: Access blocked by an administrator policy
error.CD-3003.fix: In the Google Admin console, mark the app as trusted under Security > API controls.
error.CD-3004.title: Sign-in cancelled
error.CD-3004.fix: Start the sign-in again and allow access in the browser.
error.CD-3005.title: Sign-in timed out
error.CD-3005.fix: The sign-in in the browser was not completed in time. Please try again.
error.CD-3006.title: Cloud storage is full
error.CD-3006.fix: Free up space or upgrade your storage plan at the provider.
error.CD-3007.title: Sign-in port 53682 is in use
error.CD-3007.fix: Another program (often a second rclone) uses the port. Close it and try again.
error.CD-3008.title: Sign-in failed
error.CD-3008.fix: Check the internet connection and try signing in again.
error.CD-3009.title: Signed in with a different account
error.CD-3009.fix:
Sign in with the account that belongs to this entry - you can switch accounts in the browser.
The previous sign-in stays unchanged.
error.CD-3010.title: This account is already set up
error.CD-3010.fix: Add more folders of this account as additional drives under "Manage drives".
error.CD-3011.title: Setup after the sign-in failed
error.CD-3011.fix:
The sign-in in the browser worked, the setup afterwards did not: the provider refused a request (such as which drives belong to the account) or rclone asked an unexpected question (see the details).
If the provider has a disruption, try again later. If the error persists, create a support bundle under "Diagnosis & help".
error.CD-4001.title: Drive letter is in use
error.CD-4001.fix: Choose a different letter (e.g. a NAS or USB drive already uses it).
error.CD-4002.title: Drive did not become ready in time
error.CD-4002.fix: Please connect again. If that does not help, check the log for details.
error.CD-4003.title: Mounting failed
error.CD-4003.fix: Details are in the log. Connecting again often helps.
error.CD-4004.title: Disconnecting failed
error.CD-4004.fix: Close programs that still have files open on the drive and try again.
error.CD-4005.title: No free drive letter
error.CD-4005.fix: Free up a drive letter (e.g. disconnect a network drive).
error.CD-4007.title: Folder not found
error.CD-4007.fix: Check the folder name. When a new vault is created, its folder is created automatically.
error.CD-4006.title: Uploads are still pending
error.CD-4006.fix: Wait until all files are uploaded, or disconnect with --force (uploads resume later).
error.CD-5001.title: No internet connection
error.CD-5001.fix: Check the connection. Drives are connected as soon as the internet is reachable.
error.CD-5002.title: The background service cannot get a network port
error.CD-5002.fix: Please try again. If the error persists, a firewall may block local connections.
error.CD-5003.title: Background service not reachable
error.CD-5003.fix: Connect the drives again - the service is restarted automatically.
error.CD-5004.title: Background service could not start
error.CD-5004.fix: Details are in the log (menu item "Open logs").
error.CD-6001.title: Wrong vault password or the folder is not a vault
error.CD-6001.fix: Check password and salt in the recovery kit. The vault is not mounted to protect your data.
error.CD-6002.title: Vault check file is missing
error.CD-6002.fix: The folder is not a CloudDrives vault or was modified.
error.CD-6003.title: The vault key is missing on this PC
error.CD-6003.fix: Remove the vault drive and add it again with password and salt from the recovery kit.
error.CD-6004.title: Invalid vault folder
error.CD-6004.fix: Please enter a folder name, e.g. CloudDrives-Vault.
error.CD-7001.title: Not enough space for the cache
error.CD-7001.fix: Free up space on the cache drive or reduce the cache size in the settings.
error.CD-7002.title: Errors in the local cache
error.CD-7002.fix: Disconnect and reconnect the drives. Details are in the log.
error.CD-8001.title: No CloudDrives application at the given location
error.CD-8001.fix: Start the installation from a completely extracted CloudDrives folder.
error.CD-8002.title: CloudDrives already runs from the install folder
error.CD-8002.fix: Nothing to do. For a new version: Settings > Check for updates.
error.CD-8003.title: Installation failed
error.CD-8003.fix: The previous version was left unchanged. Details are in the log.
error.CD-8004.title: No published version found yet
error.CD-8004.fix: As soon as a version is published on GitHub, CloudDrives can update itself.
error.CD-8005.title: The update package is invalid
error.CD-8005.fix: The update was not installed for security reasons. Please try again later.
error.CD-9003.title: The support bundle contained confidential data and was discarded
error.CD-9003.fix: Please report this as a bug. You can look at the logs in %LOCALAPPDATA%\CloudDrives\logs yourself.
error.CD-9004.title: The Windows Task Scheduler is not available
error.CD-9004.fix: Check that the Task Scheduler service is running. Without it CloudDrives does not reconnect automatically after standby or a crash.
error.CD-9000.title: Unknown error
error.CD-9000.fix: Details are in the log (menu item "Open logs").
error.CD-9001.title: Unexpected internal error
error.CD-9001.fix: Please check the log and report the error.
error.CD-9002.title: CloudDrives is busy
error.CD-9002.fix: Another CloudDrives action is still running. Please wait a moment and try again.
